user_query: I'm planning a surprise baby shower for my sister and need to invite her friends. Can you help me validate the phone numbers of all the guests on my list? Additionally, I want to verify their email addresses to send out the digital invitations. It would be great if you could assist me with that.

TaskList.description: Collect the list of phone numbers of all the guests.
Validate the collected phone numbers using a phone number validation API.
Collect the list of email addresses of all the guests.
Verify the collected email addresses using an email validation API.
